sections.title: Introduction
sections.text:
Garden of Terror is a 3-lane Map belonging to the Nexus universe.
The signature Objective of this Map are Seeds required to get Garden Terrors.
One per lane, the Garden Terrors will fight alongside the team who gets 3 Seeds, temporarily
disabling enemy Structures on their path.

sections.title: Lane Assignments
sections.text:
Here you can find one or more formations
that are viable on this Map. Keep in mind that positions in lane
are not strict and will often change based on the situation.

sections.title: Formation 1-1-3
Formation 1-3-1
Map Strategy
sections.text:
When possible, send a Hero with mobility
to scout the enemy Bruiser Camp. If the enemy team is clearing it,
start clearing the allied Siege Camp in the same lane and capture it
about 15 seconds after the enemy team captures their Bruiser Camp,
so that Siege Giants will help you while defending the Fort.
At 0:30 or whenever available,
start clearing the allied Siege Camp in the middle lane
and capture it as soon as possible.
To make this Mercenary Camp join the lane behind allied Minions,
capture it at 0:42 minutes or 12 seconds after a wave of Minions spawned.
At 0:45 minutes or right after capturing the allied Siege Camp in the middle lane,
start clearing the allied Bruiser Camp in the side lane
and capture it as soon as possible.
To make this Mercenary Camp join the lane in front of allied Minions,
capture it at 1:12 minutes or 12 seconds after a wave of Minions spawned.
At 1:45 minutes or 30-40 seconds before the next Objective phase,
if the allied Siege Camp in the side lane is NOT in the same lane as the next Seed location
and you did not use it in response to the enemy Bruiser Camp,
start clearing the allied Siege Camp in the side lane
and capture it as soon as possible.
To make this Mercenary Camp join the lane behind allied Minions,
capture it at 2:12 minutes or 12 seconds after a wave of Minions spawned.
If you want to contest the next Seed, be there in time with 4 Heroes
while 1 Hero defends enemy Mercenaries and then joins the team
at the Objective. If it is the first Seed of the game,
the Offlaner can keep soaking.
If you want to give the next Seed, poke
with a couple of Heroes and let the rest of your team
push in the opposite lane from the Objective.
When you reach 3 Seeds, push side lanes.
Do not forget to soak in this phase.
If you lose the Objective, try to save as many Forts and Keeps as possible.
In case the enemy team is playing grouped, however, you must immediately retreat from
the lane near them while your teammates get value elsewhere.

sections.title: Mercenary Camps
Siege Camp
sections.text:
This type of Mercenary Camp features 2 Siege Giants. Once captured,
it spawns the same units fighting for your team in the corresponding lane.
When possible, push with them to get more value.
Spawn Time
Respawn Delay
0:30 minutes
3:00 minutes after its last capture
Baseline Experience
Experience Scaling
280 Experience
+4 Experience per minute (*)
(*) For this Mercenary Camp, Experience starts scaling after 1 minute.
Instead of attacking enemies with Basic Attacks, Siege Giants throw stones at them.
These stones can be dodged, so it is possible to capture them without taking any damage.
Once captured, they are capable of damaging enemy Structures without getting in their range.
Siege Giants deal 100% bonus damage to Structures.

sections.title: Bruiser Camp
sections.text:
This type of Mercenary Camp features 3 Knights and 1 Wizard. Once captured,
it spawns the same units fighting for your team in the corresponding lane.
When possible, push with them to get more value.
Spawn Time
Respawn Delay
0:30 minutes
4:00 minutes after its last capture
Baseline Experience
Experience Scaling
450 Experience
+9 Experience per minute (*)
(*) For this Mercenary Camp, Experience starts scaling after 1 minute.
Right after being captured and while in lane, the Wizard creates a Spell Armor field
around him which reduces some of the damage taken by Minions, Mercenaries, and Heroes within range.
Avoid fighting the enemy team if they still have a Wizard helping them!

sections.title: Map Objective
sections.text:
The signature Objective of Garden of Terror consists of Seeds required to get Garden Terrors.
In order to collect a Seed, Heroes have to channel for 6 seconds.
Seeds also spawn a Regeneration Globe when collected.
The first team who gets 3 Seeds will spawn a Garden Terror per lane.
You should push with them once they reach
enemy Structures and start hitting them.
Spawn Time
Respawn Delay
2:30 minutes
from 0:50 to 1:20 minutes after collecting a Seed, from 1:30 to 2:00 minutes after all Garden Terrors die

Fight the Shamblers
At night, Shamblers will rise from the gardens.
Collect Seeds
Kill the Shamblers and collect seeds for your team.
Control Garden Terror
With 100 seeds, control a garden terror and destroy your enemies!
Seeds can spawn in 6 possible locations, with each Objective phase
having only 1 Seed active. The spawning rules are:
the first Seed is always bottom-left or bottom-right;
a Seed cannot be in the same row as the previous one;
3 consecutive Seeds are always in 3 different columns.

sections.title: Seeds Sequences
Garden Terror
sections.text:
While approaching enemy Structures, Garden Terrors spawn an Overgrowth
that takes damage equal to 10% of its maximum Health every second and disables
enemy Structures as long as it is alive, for up to 10 seconds.
When attacking, use it to push
or even dive when possible.
When defending, destroy it as quickly as possible
to enable your Structures again.

sections.title: Core Ability
sections.text:
Every 5 seconds, the Core shoots a Seed under a nearby enemy Hero.
When the seed explodes, Heroes inside are
Polymorphed for 3 seconds.

sections.title: Win Conditions
sections.text:
To win the game on Garden of Terror, you should count on
any of the following win conditions:
Map Objective,
Split-push.

sections.title: Tips and Tricks
sections.text:
Use the first Healing Fountain (2-minute cooldown) before 0:30 minutes
because the first Objective on this Map activates at 2:30 minutes,
so you will have it back in time for that.
Depending on where the next Seed is, you should decide if you want
to contest it or not. Seeds on the enemy side of the battlefield are harder
to contest whereas Seeds on your side of the battlefield are easier to contest.
If you want to contest the next Seed, be there in time with 4 Heroes
while 1 Hero defends enemy Mercenaries and then joins the team
at the Objective. If it is the first Seed of the game,
the Offlaner can keep soaking.
If you are not ready to contest or capture a Seed,
do not kill the Shamblers that are defending it.
They will slow down the enemy team while your team gets ready.
To capture a Seed as quick as possible, one Hero should distract the Shamblers
by taking aggro and another Hero should click on the Seed.
Garden Terrors spawn an Overgrowth that disables enemy Structures.
When attacking, use it to dive when possible.
When defending, destroy it to enable your Structures again.
Global Heroes should ideally take care
of the lane that is farther away from the next Objective location,
so that they can use their global tool
to quickly join their team during the next Objective phase.
See our Map Guides page for further information »
